title: RAW UNREVIEWED: f46v small heads and surrounding bracts refer to different plant parts
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. The admitted f46v drawing has multiple small bracted heads, conflicting with the public PAEONIA expansion in GDT1087. Seek a dated illustrated entry that explicitly distinguishes the enclosing bract or involucre from the head it surrounds and connects each to a different described property or handling step. Freeze the source entry and target part boundaries before reading text. A whole f46v reading should keep enclosure and contained head distinct; a generic peony name or flower word is not enough. No source-owned entry or Voynich word has been bound. This is raw unreviewed supply, not an experiment.

design.mechanism: Enclosing and enclosed floral structures play different written roles under one plant owner
design.unit: the complete admitted f46v image and its owned text
design.contrast: bract-to-head containment relation versus a single undifferentiated flower head
design.prediction: Any fixed reading has to preserve which visible part encloses which and the source-specific relation; if those parts cannot be separated in the stylized image, no semantic decision follows.
